jobs.title: Director, Product Software Engineering | Platform Engineering and Architecture
jobs.description:
About the Role:

As a Director in Software Engineering, you will provide comprehensive leadership to senior managers and high-level professionals. You will have primary responsibility for the performance and results within your area, ensuring that all software engineering activities align with business strategies. Your role is crucial for steering the direction of major projects and technological advancements that will drive the company forward.

Job Description:

We are seeking a “full-stack” engineering Director to hire and lead a team that will be responsible for selection provides leadership to > 600 engineers on the use, adoption and automation around infrastructure as code, the operational management of container deployment platforms and the CI/CD and applications required. Additionally, they will be engaged on incidents for triage and resolution along with driving teams to implement automation to address., implement, and continuously improve the developer enablement and infrastructure platform, accelerating product delivery and operational excellence across Kubernetes-based environments. The ideal candidate will understand how to guide the definition, execution, and governance of release processes and platform capabilities; operates with broad latitude and accountability for outcomes aligned to divisional strategy. Work is performed without appreciable direction and is evaluated on execution against defined plans and strategy, with measurable impact on divisional results.

SUPERVISORY RELATIONSHIPS

Reports To: VP of Platform Engineering & Architecture
Supervises: Senior managers, managers, and high-level professionals across developer enablement, platform engineering, and SRE functions.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

Provide strategic leadership, vision, and roadmaps for developer enablement and infrastructure engineering in a highly matrixed organization; ensure alignment with business objectives and partner teams.
Establish clear objectives, success measures, and investment priorities for the platform, balancing reliability, velocity, cost, and risk.
Model inclusive collaboration and effective communication with senior management, peers, and subordinates to drive alignment and execution.
Drive adoption of AI Developer Tools to drive speed to market and reduce developer friction.

Developer Enablement Platform Ownership

Lead the Developer Enablement team that owns the platform for releasing container-based software to Kubernetes (K8s); define platform SLAs/SLOs, roadmaps, and service catalog.
Own Akuity/Argo CD (GitOps) administration and lifecycle; define guardrails, RBAC, multi-cluster promotion strategies, and drift detection/rollback practices.
Maintain and evolve Open Application Model (OAM) templates, golden paths, and paved-road workflows to standardize microservice onboarding and runtime config.
Govern end-to-end container release processes (policy, controls, approvals, and tooling), including promotion workflows, artifact provenance (SBOM/SLSA), and progressive delivery (blue/green, canary).
Integrate and Maintain Developer Enablement metrics reporting into central data lake environments.
Infrastructure Development & SRE Team Buildout
Staff, train, and mature a new team that becomes the core of infrastructure development and SRE; define role architecture, hiring profiles, onboarding plans, and growth paths.
Deliver platform capabilities as products (self-service, APIs, documentation, runbooks), enabling product teams to design, provision, and operate infrastructure consistently.
Train and assist engineering teams with infrastructure design and deployment (networking, storage, data, security, observability), while performing hands-on engineering to ensure deployments and operations are fully automated (IaC, GitOps, policy-as-code, CI/CD).
Establish site reliability practices—SLO/SLI, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, and capacity/performance engineering—aligned with product objectives.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

Define release governance and change management controls (e.g., segregation of duties, approval workflows, audit trails) integrated into platform tooling, partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance for continuous assurance.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and secure-by-design practices across the software supply chain.

Job Qualifications

Education
(Required):

Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and relevant experience in product software engineering.

Work Experience (Required):

Minimum 9+ years of relevant experience in product software engineering or platform/SRE leadership roles.
People management experience
Experience in Matrixed environments.
Knowledge and interest in AI
Technical competence in platform engineering and architecture

Preferred Experience & Knowledge (Role-Specific):

Platform engineering for Kubernetes at scale (multi-cluster/multi-region), GitOps (Argo CD/Akuity), service meshes, secrets management.
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi), policy-as-code (OPA/Gatekeeper), progressive delivery (Argo Rollouts/Flagger).
CI/CD at enterprise scale (artifact provenance, SBOM/SLSA), container security, and supply chain controls.
Observability platforms (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerts) and incident management practices.
Coaching product teams; operating in a matrixed enterprise with strong stakeholder management.

Skills / Competencies

Technical/Operational Skills

DevOps & Agile delivery; automation and continuous delivery at scale.
Cloud computing (Azure/AWS/GCP) and modern application architectures; API-first enablement.
Automation & Frameworks for standardized delivery and code manageability across teams.
Application Security and secure SDLC; Architectural Patterns for scalable, resilient systems.
Financial/Budget Management for platform services and shared-service cost models that includes understanding of how to use technology to drive cost reductions while increasing value delivery. This requires budget, technical and operational competencies.
Experience in both use of AI Coding tools personally and in driving adoption of those in developer teams.

Leadership Competencies

Accountability; Judgement & Decision-Making; Business Acumen to drive measurable outcomes.
Inclusive Collaboration; Inspiration & Alignment; Courage to take smart risks that enable innovation.
People Management: delegation, coaching, performance management, and talent development.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Velocity & Flow: Lead time for change; deployment frequency; PR cycle time (open-to-merge).
Reliability: Service SLO attainment; MTTI/MTTR; change failure rate.
Adoption & Self-Service: of services on Gantry; % workloads on paved paths/OAM templates; % infra as code.
Quality & Security: Policy compliance rate; supply-chain attestations; pipeline pass rate; vulnerability MTTR.
Experience & Enablement: Developer NPS; onboarding time to first deploy; “friction index” trend.
Overall infrastructure cost reduction while increasing all of the above.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Travel: 20%
Work Arrangement: Hybrid onsite in the WK posted locations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$179,200.00 - $320,200.00 USD

This role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information
:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering & Automation
jobs.description:
As a Director, AI Engineering & Automation, you will be accountable for leading the execution of the AI strategy within our Corporate Finance Division. This role requires a proven ability to set direction, drive end-to-end delivery, and deliver measurable business impact in complex, regulated environments.

You'll thrive in this position if you bring executive presence, strategic clarity, and the ability to mobilize diverse teams towards a common vision—combining deep expertise in AI and financial systems with a passion for transformative innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement solutions EAD the execution of the AI strategy for Corporate Finance, , ensuring alignment with Nasdaq's global objectives and delivering significant business value.
Inspire, develop, and empower a team of AI professionals to deliver excellence at scale, providing leadership, mentorship, and accountability for outcomes and measurable impact.
Drive operational discipline and end-to-end delivery execution by overseeing the development of Generative AI solutions and AI-powered automations that enhance decision-making and efficiency, ensuring code quality, performance, and reliability.
Be a thought leader in the team's adoption of best practices in software development.
Collaborate with senior stakeholders across finance and technology to identify opportunities for AI-driven transformation and ensure alignment on strategic priorities.
Collaborate effectively within geographically dispersed teams
Champion innovation and best practices in AI/ML, staying at the forefront of industry developments and guiding technical direction for model development, data curation, and scalable solution delivery.
Lead large, cross-functional delivery teams with persuasive communication, resource allocation expertise, and the ability to manage complex risks that impact long-term departmental success.

Required Qualifications

Extensive leadership experience in AI solution delivery, technology execution, or a comparable role within finance or fintech organizations.
Strong proficiency in Python, with a good understanding of its ecosystem and best practices.
Proficiency with AWS and cloud technologies.
Experience of infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform
Knowledge with Visual Studio Code and other modern development environments
Deep understanding of Generative AI concepts, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and their practical applications to deliver solutions to real-world business challenges.
Proficiency with version control systems, particularly Git.
Strong executive presence with exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
Track record of building, and leading high-performing delivery teams across functions delivering impactful AI solutions on time and at scale.
In-depth knowledge of finance-related processes, financial data, accounting systems, and regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Python and agile software development methodologies, with superior delivery management and strategic thinking abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree (e.g., MBA) or equivalent senior leadership training a plus.
10+ years of experience in development, AI/ML solution delivery, or software development, with experience utilizing LLMs, RAG, RPA, or web-scraping valued.
Prior experience working within or supporting Corporate Finance organizations in capital markets or regulated industries.
Familiarity with Spec-Driven Development Methodologies
Experience with RPA (e.g., Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) a plus.

This position will be located in New York
and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days
a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

What We Offer

We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.

The base pay range for this role is $134,000 - $248,000. In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short-term incentive), and equity (long-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

Nasdaq’s programs and rewards are intended to allow our employees to:

Secure Wealth: 401(k) program with 6% employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Program with 15% discount, Student loan repayment program up to $10k, Company paid life and disability plans, Generous paid time off
Prioritize Health: Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, Health spending account with employer contribution, Paid flex days to support mental wellbeing, Gym membership discounts
Care for Family: Hybrid home/office schedule (for most positions), Paid parental leave, Fertility benefits, Paid bereavement leave
Connect with Community: Company gift matching program, Employee resource groups, Paid volunteer days
Grow Career: Education Assistance Program, Robust job skills training and Professional development opportunities

For more information, visit
Nasdaq Benefits & Rewards Career page .

jobs.title: Director, AI Platform Engineering & DevOps
jobs.description:
The Director, AI Platform Engineering & DevOp
s will be responsible for leading the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operational enablement of enterprise AI, Kubernetes, GPU, and DevOps platforms. This role partners with infrastructure engineering, application development, data science teams, and business stakeholders to design scalable, secure, cost-effective, and operationally sustainable AI and cloud-native platforms.

The role supports enterprise adoption of Private AI, Generative AI, GPU-based computing, Kubernetes-based platform services, RunAI capabilities, automation, and DevOps practices. The position is accountable for helping business and technical teams evaluate AI use cases, onboard workloads, optimize infrastructure investments, and accelerate developer and data science productivity.

Essential Functions

Define and drive architecture strategy for enterprise AI, Private AI, Generative AI, GPU, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platform services.
Lead design and evolution of scalable GPU infrastructure to support AI, machine learning, LLM, data science, and high-performance compute workloads.
Provide Kubernetes platform leadership, including workload orchestration, containerized platform design, resource management, scalability, reliability, and operational governance.
Advance DevOps practices across platform services, including CI/CD enablement, automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, deployment repeatability, and operational efficiency.
Partner with developers, data scientists, application architects, business architects, enterprise architecture, and business leaders to assess AI use cases and determine appropriate platform solutions.
Evaluate technology options, vendor capabilities, infrastructure designs, GPU configurations, networking, storage, and platform tooling to support enterprise AI objectives.
Drive adoption of AI platform services by conducting workshops, technical discovery sessions, onboarding activities, demos, and enablement sessions for development and data science teams.
Support platform users through onboarding, troubleshooting, technical guidance, requirements analysis, and operational support
Work with business and technical teams to ensure AI infrastructure solutions are not treated as simple checklist items, but are designed correctly for application, availability, migration, and business requirements.
Develop technical proposals, business cases, architecture recommendations, and cost optimization plans for AI and GPU platform investments.
Lead capacity planning and future-state roadmap development for AI platform growth, GPU expansion, workload onboarding, and Private AI adoption.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture teams to align AI and platform engineering capabilities with broader enterprise technology direction.
Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, enable on-prem AI alternatives, reduce public cloud AI service costs, and support business-driven AI initiatives.
Mentor and guide junior or supporting resources to scale platform support, improve knowledge transfer, and reduce dependency on senior architecture resources.
Ensure platform solutions are implemented in alignment with Enterprise Standards, InfoSec expectations, operational processes, and infrastructure best practices.

Experience Required

Requires extensive experience in enterprise infrastructure architecture, platform engineering, Kubernetes, DevOps, cloud-native technologies, AI/ML infrastructure, or high-performance computing environments.

Experience Should Include Several Of The Following

Designing and supporting enterprise Kubernetes or container platforms.
Supporting DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and infrastructure as code practices.
Architecting GPU-based infrastructure for AI, machine learning, or high-performance compute workloads.
Working with AI/ML platforms, Generative AI, LLM hosting approaches, or Private AI solutions.
Partnering with developers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Performing vendor evaluations, technical comparisons, platform recommendations, and cost-benefit analysis.
Leading complex cross-functional technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operational support.

Education Required

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
Equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant enterprise technology experience may be considered.

Additional Experience

Experience with RunAI or similar AI/GPU orchestration platforms preferred.
Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms and AI infrastructure ecosystems preferred.
Experience with hybrid cloud, private cloud, virtualization, networking, storage, and enterprise compute platforms preferred.
Experience supporting AI adoption, developer enablement, workshops, platform onboarding, or technical evangelization preferred.
Experience preparing executive-level architecture recommendations, investment proposals, and technical roadmaps preferred.

Key Skills And Abilities

Very strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare proposals, summaries, roadmaps, and executive-ready recommendations.
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, platform engineering, and cloud-native architecture.
Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, infrastructure as code, automation, and operational process improvement.
Strong understanding of GPU infrastructure, AI/ML workloads, LLM infrastructure requirements, and high-performance compute design.
Ability to evaluate complex technical options and recommend scalable, cost-effective, enterprise-ready solutions.
Ability to translate complex AI, infrastructure, and platform concepts into clear business and leadership recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across infrastructure, architecture, development, data science, and business teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on performance, scalability, resiliency, cost optimization, and operational readiness.
Ability to lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, demos, onboarding sessions, and enablement activities.
Ability to mentor technical resources and support knowledge transfer across teams.
Ability to work under limited direction and lead complex initiatives across multiple teams and priorities.

Director, Technology Infrastructure Architecture

Duties & Responsibilities:

Builds and leads the Technology Infrastructure Architecture (TIA) function as a new, dedicated team, ensuring security is integrated seamlessly into enterprise infrastructure projects from the design phase, accelerating safe technology delivery
Responsible for long-range secure infrastructure architecture strategy and planning across cloud, on-premise, and endpoint environments supporting both retail and enterprise operations
Acts as the face of the TIA team to the business and the primary liaison between TIA, senior IT leadership, Operations teams, Information Security, and Engineering leaders; ensures TIA is engaged early in business projects
Manages the cross functional team for architecture reviews and new business projects; defines and tracks team KPIs (e.g., shift-left engagement, design flaw reduction)
Embeds cybersecurity principles into all architecture decisions; drives secure-by-design principles, zero trust adoption, threat modeling, and network segmentation standards in partnership with Information Security
Enforces established security reference architectures and standards — identity and access, network segmentation, ZTNA/SASE, encryption, and cloud security posture — throughout project designs and reviews
Operates as a hands-on player-coach — prototypes, builds reference architectures, and works alongside engineers to unblock delivery, bringing velocity to new projects rather than governance overhead
Leads implementation and enterprise change management for infrastructure and security initiatives — plans, sequences, and drives changes through build, testing, and rollout, ensuring architectural decisions are executed and adopted across store and enterprise environments rather than handed off
Partners closely with the existing Network Operations organization to ensure new designs are operable, observable, and transition cleanly into steady-state support
Owns budget planning and management for the TIA team, including capital and operating forecasts for new projects, and provides architectural input to cloud cost governance (FinOps) and infrastructure investment decisions
Champions and personally contributes to automation and infrastructure-as-code practices and the adoption of AI-driven operations (AIOps) to shift the organization from reactive to predictive operations
Evaluates and pilots emerging networking technologies (e.g., SASE, micro segmentation, cloud-native IaC, AI-assisted operational automation) hands-on before recommending broad adoption
Identifies interdependencies and emerging trends across interrelated technology efforts and programs to continuously improve infrastructure services
Recruits, develops, and mentors architects and senior engineers for the new team; builds a culture of ownership, delivery velocity, and accountability
Manages strategic vendor and technology partner relationships supporting architecture initiatives and new-project delivery

Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or other related fields, or equivalent work experience
10+ years in Network Engineering, Enterprise Security, or Systems Architecture, with at least 3+ years in a leadership/management role influencing senior level management and key stakeholders
Highly technical and hands-on, with strong executive communication skills — able to represent the team credibly to senior leadership and engineering teams alike
Requires advanced technical and business knowledge in infrastructure and security architecture, enterprise network engineering (LAN/WAN/WLAN, SD-WAN, carrier services), and IT financial/budget management
Demonstrated cybersecurity experience: strong background in enterprise risk management and security framework adoption (NIST, CIS, PCI DSS, zero trust), applying security controls to architecture decisions and leading teams to deliver secure infrastructure
Relevant certifications a plus: CISSP, CISM, or SABSA (security); CCNP/CCIE (network); ITIL; major cloud certifications

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Director - Front Office Engineering Lead ( Full-stack) - Buy side trading solutions

At BNY, our culture empowers you to grow and succeed. As a leading global financial services company at the centre of the world’s financial system, we touch nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day around the globe, our 50,000+ employees bring the power of their perspective to the table to create solutions with our clients that benefit businesses, communities and people everywhere.

We continue to be a leader in the industry, awarded as a top home for innovators and for creating an inclusive workplace. Through our unique ideas and talents, together we help make money work for the world. This is what is all about.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Front Office Engineering Lead ( Full-stack) to join our BUY SIDE TRADING BUSINESS as part of CAPITAL MARKETS team. This role is open in New York city, NY.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer to manage and drive business expansion through an engineering lens. Working closely with a cross-asset desk as we design, architect, and build a state-of-the-art platform to empower extensive reporting capabilities, research, and real-time analytics, in support of our new global, multi-asset trading organization.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Architecture & Design Leadership: Play a lead role in the design, architecture and implementation of trading, sales, and operations workflows, ensuring alignment with business goals and engineering best practices.
Trade-Flow Platform Development: Design and build flexible, scalable trade-flow software capable of handling diverse client-side and OMS-side integration patterns and high-throughput scenarios.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Trading, Operations, and Engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions.
Technology Innovation: Work alongside a cross-functional engineering team to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, contributing to a modern, high-performance technology stack.
AI-Driven Automation: Champion an AI-first mindset by driving automation initiatives, intelligent code refactoring, and the adoption of AI tooling to improve developer productivity and system efficiency.
Engineering Excellence: Deliver well-designed, testable, secure, and performant code through hands-on programming, rigorous code reviews, and adherence to engineering standards.
Production Support: Provide second-level production support, troubleshoot complex system issues, and contribute to incident resolution and post-mortem processes.
Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, technical growth, and engineering craftsmanship.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required, advanced degree preferred.
Industry Experience: 14 plus years of experience designing, building, and delivering real-time, scalable, and resilient software applications within Financial Services or similarly complex, high-throughput domains.
Data & Persistence: Strong command of relational and analytical database technologies, e.g., KDB / ClickHouse / Oracle, with experience in data modelling, query optimization, and large-scale data management.
Messaging & Middleware: Hands-on experience with messaging and middleware technologies such as Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, FIX protocol, with an understanding of event-driven and asynchronous system design.
Agile Delivery: Solid understanding of Scrum and Agile methodologies, with a proven ability to deliver in fast-paced, rapidly evolving environments with shifting priorities.
Communication & Leadership: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong organizational skills to coordinate, influence, and drive cross-team initiatives.
Problem Solving & Innovation: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex, ambiguous problems and devise pragmatic, innovative solutions — balancing technical rigor with delivery speed.
AI-Augmented Development: Familiarity with one or more AI coding and productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code), with a willingness to leverage AI-assisted workflows to accelerate development and improve code quality.
Experience working with Execution Management Systems (EMS) and Order Management Systems (OMS).

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:

BNY Newsroom

BNY LinkedIn

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025
Our Benefits and Rewards:

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

ABOUT US

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Overview

Mastercard Send, part of the Mastercard Move portfolio, powers near real-time money movement to billions of cards, bank, and digital accounts worldwide. The platform enables financial institutions, fintechs, businesses, and digital partners to deliver fast, secure, and reliable payment experiences across domestic and cross-border use cases.

The ideal candidate is a skilled technology executive with deep expertise in software architecture, software development, operational excellence, and organizational leadership. This role partners closely with Product, Operations, Security, Risk, and other technology leaders to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that support Mastercard's global payments ecosystem.

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane
, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane
—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable
.

Our mission
is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents
. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies
and platform engineers across 100+ countries
. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads
and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide
. We’re a Series B
company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital
, and we’ve raised $69M
to date. Learn more at upbound.io
.

Upbound is building the control plane for the modern enterprise. As the company behind Crossplane, the open-source CNCF project that extends Kubernetes into an AI-native cloud control plane, Upbound enables organizations to compose, manage, and operate infrastructure and services through declarative, programmable control planes. Upbound Cloud delivers hosted, multi-tenant control planes that power platform engineering teams at scale.

The Management Plane is how customers experience all of it. It is the unified API surface, the interface they work in, the catalog they discover content through, and the systems that connect, license, and bill everything they run. As we scale into the next phase of growth, we are hiring a Senior Manager to lead this group.

Areas of Ownership

Hub — The Upbound Hub API, which indexes and aggregates control planes across an organization and provides unified API access, multi-tenancy, and organization context regardless of where those control planes run.
Console — The primary frontend client and user experience for the entire Upbound platform, spanning single control plane views, multi-control-plane management, and organization-level operations.
Marketplace — The distribution and discovery layer where users and customers find providers, functions, configurations, and extensions.
Middleware — The platform services the business depends on: billing and metering, licensing and entitlements, Connect, and the identity and access plumbing that ties them together.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for growing a team, defining the architecture of the Management Plane, and ensuring these four surfaces operate as one coherent product rather than four adjacent ones.

In this role, you will …

Management Plane Strategy

Own the long-term technical direction for Hub, Console, Marketplace, and middleware. Ensure they present a single coherent experience to customers whether their control planes run in Upbound Cloud or in their own environment. Define the architectural direction for the Hub API, multi-tenancy, and organization-level identity and access management. Drive the reliability and performance standards these surfaces are held to.

Middleware and Commerce

Own the systems that turn product usage into revenue: metering, usage aggregation, billing, licensing, and entitlement enforcement. Ensure these systems are accurate, auditable, and resilient, and that they can support new packaging and pricing without a rewrite each time. Partner with Finance and Revenue on the operational side of billing correctness.

AI-Native Access

Ensure the Hub API is a first-class interface for autonomous agents as well as human operators, with the declarative, programmatic access agentic workflows require. Evolve the Console toward a multi-modal experience that works alongside those workflows rather than around them.

Team Leadership

Lead senior ICs and tech leads directly. Grow the team deliberately against the roadmap, raise the hiring bar, and develop engineers into senior and lead roles. Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, on-call ownership, and production excellence across the Management Plane surfaces.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product, Design, GTM, Finance, and Customer Success. Translate enterprise requirements around security, multi-tenancy, packaging, and entitlements into platform capabilities. Represent the Management Plane in conversations about pricing changes, packaging, and customer-facing reliability.

You are a good fit if you have…

7+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers directly
Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS products at scale
Strong API design fundamentals, including versioning, backward compatibility, and designing for third-party consumers
Hands-on experience with at least one commerce or platform middleware domain: billing, metering, licensing, entitlements, or identity and access management
Track record of owning production reliability for customer-facing services, including incident response and on-call culture
Has built or intentionally restructured a team, not only inherited one
Technically credible with senior and principal engineers while operating at the roadmap level

Skills / Traits

Leadership: Sets direction and quality standards for a group of senior engineers who need clarity more than supervision. Earns followership through judgment and technical credibility rather than title.
People Management: Develops engineers deliberately toward their next level, runs consistent 1:1s and feedback loops, and addresses underperformance directly instead of waiting for a review cycle.
Decision-Making: Makes calls with incomplete information on a surface where reversals are expensive. A published API, a data model, or a billing schema is hard to walk back, so the bar for thinking a decision through is higher here than in most teams.
Communication: Translates fluently between engineering, Product, Design, Finance, and GTM. Writes clearly enough that a pricing change or an API deprecation can be understood by everyone it affects without a meeting.
Problem-Solving: Drives to root cause on correctness problems rather than stopping at a mitigation. Comfortable reasoning about a discrepancy that only shows up in one tenant's invoice.
Prioritization: Balances roadmap commitments against revenue-blocking middleware work, reliability debt, and customer escalations, and can explain the tradeoff to the people who lost the argument.
Project Management: Delivers predictably across four tightly coupled surfaces where a Hub API change can block Console and Marketplace at the same time. Manages dependencies and sequencing without adding process for its own sake.
Adaptability: Absorbs shifts in packaging, pricing, and agentic access requirements without rearchitecting each time. Adjusts approach when a framework or plan stops serving the team.
Risk Management: Treats billing accuracy, entitlement enforcement, and API compatibility as areas where mistakes cost real money and customer trust. Builds the guardrails, auditability, and testing to catch problems before customers do.
Technical Proficiency: Credible in API design, multi-tenant data modeling, and identity and access patterns, with enough frontend depth to lead Console work substantively rather than defer on it.

It is a plus if you have…

Familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem
Frontend or full-stack depth, enough to lead Console work substantively
Experience with marketplaces, developer catalogs, or package distribution systems
Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the systems behind them
Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure or developer-tools companies
Familiarity with how AI agents consume infrastructure APIs

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

We are seeking a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to Lead our R&D Team working in partnership with the CIO on developing the Technical Strategy to implement the Corporate Vision. A strong leader with excellent communication skills, a wide breath of technical competencies and a history of success with delivering new and innovative apps. jobs.description:
Does this position interest you? You should apply – even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.

A Brief Overview

The Senior Manager of BI Engineering and Data Products
will lead the technical execution of complex, enterprise analytics initiatives and build a high-performing BI Engineering and Data Products organization.
This position will set technical and architectural direction for scalable, governed BI platforms and data products, partner closely with Data Engineering and IT engineering teams to solve ambiguous problems, and translate enterprise priorities into durable roadmaps that deliver trusted analytics outcomes at scale.

Expected Work Location (In Office)
: It is expected that you will primarily perform work at the Safelite Home Office (7400 Safelite Way, Columbus, OH 43235). You are required to work in the office at least 4 days a week. Changes to work location arrangements are subject to managerial approval and business needs.

What You Will Do

Provide technical and people leadership for the BI Engineering and Data Products team: Sets architectural direction and governs BI engineering standards to ensure scalable, reliable analytics solutions. Manages and develops BI Engineers and BI Developers through performance management, coaching, and workforce planning, and serves as the escalation point for complex, cross‑functional technical and delivery issues.
Scope, decompose, and lead execution of complex BI engineering problems across a variety of functional areas: Analyzes ambiguous business and analytical needs and translates them into well‑defined BI engineering designs and work plans. Deconstructs complex or legacy reporting workflows and guides the application of computer science and analytics engineering principles to ensure solutions are performant, extensible, and maintainable.
Oversee BI pipeline engineering quality and delivery: Ensures end‑to‑end quality of BI pipelines from semantic and metrics layers through dashboards and downstream data products by establishing and enforcing standards for data modeling, testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD. Drives consistent engineering practices to improve reliability, scalability, and speed of analytics delivery.
Design and evolve BI semantic and reporting architecture: Leads the design and continuous improvement of shared semantic layers, metrics frameworks, and reusable BI components. Partners closely with Data Engineering and IT engineering teams to align BI solutions with enterprise data platforms, ingestion patterns, and architectural standards, enabling scalable self‑service analytics.
Define and communicate business and technical value of BI initiatives: Quantifies the impact of BI solutions and communicates value to Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to inform prioritization, sequencing, and investment decisions. Ensures BI roadmaps balance business outcomes, technical complexity, and architectural alignment.
Establish and oversee BI platform governance and operations: Directs governance and operational management of BI platforms, including Tableau Cloud administration, access controls, content certification, automation, and quality monitoring. Ensures BI platforms operate as stable, well‑governed engineering systems with clear ownership and observability.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards

Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, or related field Required
7-9 years hands on experience in a data engineering or analytics related role Required
4-6 years managing a technical team Required
7-9 years Advanced SQL development, including complex transformations, performance optimization, and data modeling. Required
4-6 years Experience with modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake or similar). Required
4-6 years Experience using Python or other programming languages for data transformation, automation, or analytics workflows. Required
4-6 years Experience with modern analytics engineering tools (e.g., dbt, FiveTran) and CI/CD practices. Required
Expert-level SQL knowledge, including advanced query optimization, window functions, CTEs, nested queries, and complex transformations used in enterprise analytics workflows. High (High proficiency)
Advanced proficiency in Python or similar programming languages for analytics engineering, automation, workflow orchestration, and operational reporting. High (High proficiency)
Ability to technically scope, decompose, and solve abstract analytical problems by translating ambiguous business needs into well-defined BI engineering designs using computer science and analytics engineering principles. High (High proficiency)
Deep knowledge of BI and analytics engineering architecture, including the design and evolution of governed semantic layers, metrics frameworks, and reusable analytics components. High (High proficiency)
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and data modeling best practices, including dimensional modeling, performance optimization, and alignment with upstream ingestion patterns. Medium (Medium proficiency)
Experience leading teams responsible for enterprise BI platforms, dashboards, and downstream data products built on governed semantic layers. Medium (Medium proficiency)
Ability to lead technical scoping, estimation, and business case refinement, including defining and comparing quantifiable value, complexity, and architectural impact across analytics use cases. Medium (Medium proficiency)

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical design decisions. Medium (Medium proficiency)
Sound architectural judgment to balance near-term delivery with long-term scalability, maintainability, and platform consistency. Medium (Medium proficiency)

Familiarity with modern data engineering tools, CI/CD concepts, and version control practices as they relate to analytics engineering and BI workflows. Medium (Medium proficiency)

Total job benefits valued at more than $10k*. This includes a 401(k) plan with company matching, medical coverage plans customized to suit your needs and a commitment to work/life balance through our paid time off (PTO) programs, company holidays and paid volunteer days.
Up to $5,250 in tuition reimbursement per year.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Manufacturing Engineering

Company Details:

Our company is a leader in the architectural metal products market with six operating locations in the USA. Family-owned and managed company 75 years strong. We distribute, fabricate, and finish (anodize and paint) aluminum and other products primarily for the commercial construction market.

This position will be responsible for 3 key areas:

Application Engineering and increasing revenue
Product Manager of ERP system
Engineering and Technical experience specifically with metal forming/fabrication and welding with Engineering CAD understanding.

The owners have been handling these job duties, but 1 of them is retiring in February, 2027 and would like a person to take over. Looking for experience in the metals industry and experienced with High Mix/Low Volume manufacturing environments. Essentially, possesses the final technical authority on manufacturability.

Mission

The Director of Manufacturing Engineering exists to turn technical uncertainty into revenue. When Sales brings a hard inquiry, this role's job is to know our true capability better than anyone on the floor, actively find the honest, buildable path to yes rather than defaulting to a cautious no, and build the investment case when winning the work requires new tooling. And when the honest answer really is no, this role says so — the goal is more revenue we can deliver on.

The Director of Manufacturing Engineering
is responsible for being the technical authority for how, where, and when shop orders are manufactured. This role owns enterprise-wide equipment and process capability knowledge, applying sound engineering judgment grounded in OEM specifications and hands-on manufacturing expertise to replace operator assumption and overly cautious decision-making.

Required:

Bachelor's degree in engineering (B.S.) from a four-year college or university; or ten years of related metal fabricating experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with ERP or production-scheduling systems is required.
Experienced with Lean Manufacturing philosophy and have experience with Lean tools such as visual manufacturing controls, 5S, waste reduction, and root cause analysis.
Prior application engineering or customer-facing technical solutioning experience is highly preferred.
Project management experience leading equipment installations, software deployments, or similar capital or process initiatives from planning through completion is required.
Familiarity with CAD is a plus.
Experience in a metal forming and welding environment is essential
Experience in Commercial Construction Building Products, especially aluminum window, door, skylight, curtain wall, and storefront would be a big plus.
Must have excellent communications skills

Job Responsibilities:

Serve as final technical authority on manufacturability: determine whether and how Company can fabricate and finish a given job in-house before sales quotes or declines work.
Serve as the application engineering escalation point: when Sales or a Project Manager brings a ‘can we make this?’ inquiry, actively work the problem — with Production personnel and customers as needed — to find an honest, buildable path to yes rather than defaulting to a cautious no, and equip Sales with what they need to convert a viable inquiry into a sale.
Train and equip Project Managers across all locations to make first-line manufacturability and solution decisions independently for standard requests, reserving engineering escalation for non-standard or complex jobs.
Assist with scheduling as needed: understand how Company Enterprise generates production schedules from quoted operations and standard time data, and guide General Managers, Project Managers, and administrative staff across all six branches on how to use and maintain accurate schedules.
Identify and recommend tooling and capital equipment investments that expand in-house capability, including cost and payback justification.
When Company is close to winning a job but cannot yet fulfill it without additional tooling or equipment, build a business plan for the CEO specific to that opportunity — investment required, cost, and payback — so capital decisions are made against real, near-term revenue rather than speculative capability building.
Serve as engineer-project manager for significant, approved engineering projects as needed — including new machine installations, software deployments, and other major process enhancements — owning scope, timeline, and budget from planning through completion.
Execute, configure, and maintain Company Enterprise's manufacturing ERP functionality under the CEO's product direction, including multi-branch job routing; document system logic and configuration so scheduling and routing knowledge does not depend on any single individual.
Directly manage the Compliance Management, CAD Services, and Quality Assurance functions.
Own the engineering aspects of regulatory compliance management.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance using Lean tools — visual manufacturing controls, 5S, waste reduction, and root cause analysis.
Monitor product consistency, customer complaints, safety hazards, and remakes across locations to identify systemic technical issues and drive corrective action.
Ensure staff receive timely, appropriate technical training and development. Mentor and develop staff through a supportive, collaborative approach.
Escalate unresolved disagreements with the VP of Manufacturing to the CEO for final decision.

jobs.title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Nira Energy

Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change
The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner
We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country
We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets
We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company
This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market

About The Role

This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.

The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.

The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.

Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.

The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e. <50 people and $10M in revenue, and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led in that capacity. You’ve also ideally held a prominent role at at a company that has scaled, i.e. 50-250 people and >$50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.

What you'll own

Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals
Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention
People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.
Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale

What we're looking for

A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat
A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value and can speak competently to results; i.e. Built a product from $0 to >$10M in revenue, Improve retention of a product by 30%, scaled a product from $10M to $50M etc
You are willing to be hands on and get in the weeds. This is a ~17 person org and a 30 person company. While you are ultimately in charge of managing the team we expect you to be a hands on operator and willing to roll your sleeves up
Ability and interest in learning a highly niche, complex domain fast. Transmisison planning is incredibly intricate and becoming fluent in the language of “transmission” is critical to success in the role
Low ego and mission driven. Your energized by the mission of the company and by building a team, motivating them, and partnering with world class founders
Excellent communication and people leadership skills

Ideal backgrounds

VP Product / CPO at a technical B2B SaaS company.
GM of a complex technical product line.
A product leader who has run a team or product function end to end.
A former technical or product founder who scaled into executive leadership.
Bonus points for experience in energy, grid infrastructure, climate, utilities, transmission, interconnection, or power markets, but not required

About Chalk

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About The Role

Forward Deployed Engineering is where Chalk meets its customers. Our FDEs are exceptional software engineers who integrate Chalk’s platform with the best ML and engineering teams in healthcare, finance, and consumer technology — running technical pilots that win deals, onboarding new customers, and engineering feature pipelines that power use cases like fraud prevention, cancer detection, and product recommendation.

Working directly with our founders, you'll lead this team and define its future. You'll own the strategy for how Chalk engages customers technically — from pre-sales pilots through onboarding, support, and expansion — and build the organization, processes, and playbooks that let the function scale with our growth. FDE is one of the most strategically important and fastest-growing functions at Chalk, and this role will shape what it becomes.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What You Will Do

Lead, develop, and retain Chalk's team of Forward Deployed Engineers across New York and San Francisco, and own an aggressive hiring plan as the team scales
Define the strategy and operating model for the FDE function: engagement models, account coverage, the pre-sales/post-sales balance, and how FDEs drive expansion within accounts
Own the systems that make the team run — support triage and rotations, escalation paths to Engineering, onboarding playbooks, and the processes for rolling out platform changes to customer environments
Partner closely with Sales and GTM leadership on technical pilots, evaluations, and the technical strategy behind our most important deals
Partner with Engineering leadership to channel customer learnings into the product roadmap and to sharpen the internal tooling FDEs rely on
Stay hands-on: dive into customer architectures, unblock hard technical problems, and set the technical bar for the team
Serve as an executive-level technical counterpart to customer leadership at our largest accounts
Define career paths and growth trajectories for FDEs, and champion the function's identity as we grow — deeply technical engineers embedded with customers, not sales engineering

What We're Looking For

10+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years leading customer-facing engineering teams (forward deployed, solutions architecture, field engineering, or similar)
Strong hands-on technical skills — proficient in Python and SQL, comfortable going deep on customer architectures and data infrastructure
Experience across both pre-sales and post-sales complex enterprise motions: technical pilots and evaluations as well as onboarding, support, and account expansion
Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain exceptional engineers, including senior ICs
Previous experience at an early-stage, high-growth startup
Executive-level communicator who can bridge technical, business, and customer contexts
Experience building the processes and playbooks that let a customer-facing engineering team scale
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Previous experience as a forward deployed engineer or FDE leader at a high-growth startup
Experience building production ML systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms
Experience scaling a customer-facing engineering function from single-digit to multi-team
Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (fintech, healthcare)

jobs.description:
About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!

Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.

At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.

Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.

Reporting to the VP of Global Technology, the Director of Platform Systems will be responsible for leading the evolution of our current software and infrastructure platforms, as well as building the future versions. The solutions-oriented individual will direct software engineering and DevOps teams to develop a customer-centric platform for customizing, booking, managing, and operating trips across the G Travel Community (GTC) portfolio of products. They will be accountable for architecting and scaling the underlying AWS infrastructure which hosts these applications. The candidate will help identify, plan & implement multi-year programs for all practical migrations of applications from future acquisitions, to GTC platforms. As part of the global Technology leadership, the role will be responsible for the mentorship and growth of manager and staff developer direct reports, as well as collaborate with executive leadership across the organization. They will help evolve the current organizational structure of distributed teams and lead the strategy of offshore locations.

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Play a key leadership role in developing and executing strategies that meet business objectives and enabling critical decision making
Plan integrations of current and prospective G Adventure acquisitions by identifying system synergies & conducting gap analysis to determine how to best meet business requirements
Present G Adventure product offerings to potential partners, developing white labeling and back office opportunities that leverage proprietary systems
Lead build vs buy decisions to align with product requirements and stories, architecture specifications, and customer/stakeholder needs
Work closely with Business Analysts and Project Managers team to ensure technology projects are properly scoped with the correct business stakeholders, risks are being mitigated, and transparent communication with the business is being maintained
Evolve the SDLC to improve delivery of complex software projects and provide greater predictability of timelines
Define, report and analyze a comprehensive set metrics to inform decision making on development practices
Identify engineering challenges and guide the architecture and implementation of scalable solutions

INFRASTRUCTURE

Help define the architecture, design, requirements, and tooling for the AWS infrastructure which hosts custom software applications
Maintain high availability and reliability of platform systems, by establishing and improving SLAs, SLIs, and SLOs via service performance monitoring
Lead initiatives to optimize performance, fault tolerance, and alignment with application requirements across queue-based workflows
Automate cloud infrastructure and configuration, as well as CI/CD of the hosted applications
Apply DevSecOps practices across the software lifecycle and ensure that all infrastructure complies with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR)
Oversee the design and management of complex networking environments, including VPC architecture, VPC peering, NACLs, VPNs, and multi-region setups
Develop and enforce a log management strategy that optimizes system observability and provides actionable insights
Forecast budgets for infrastructure requirements and the associated tooling

PEOPLE & LEADERSHIP

Lead, inspire, manage, and motivate a group of managers and very senior contributors while growing their leadership and technical skills
Manage the expansion of development teams in existing and new offshore locations
Monitor team member performance, set individual goals, meet for regular 1-on-1s, and perform yearly reviews
Conduct interviews to assist with hiring qualified team members
Work jointly with the Global Technology leadership team to define the technology vision, strategy, and roadmaps to ensure success
Collaborate with the Global Technology management team to define departmental policy, processes, and procedures that scale across the group of businesses
Manage communication at all levels of the organization regarding team goals and progress to those goals
Prioritize a high-volume of competing tasks in an extremely fast-paced environment, while managing stakeholder expectations

Requirements/Skills/Experience

15+ years of experience in software development, ideally with some in travel and tourism or related industries
10+ years of technical management experience
5+ years of AWS solutions architecture & services such as S3, ALB, ECS, RDS/Aurora, Elasticache, Lambda, SQS
Experience establishing and growing offshore teams
Proficiency with architecting CI/CD, accessible logging, performance monitoring, and issue dashboards using tools such as CircleCI, Datadog, Sentry
Operational experience with infrastructure provisioning/configuration tools such as Ansible, Terraform
Familiarity with containerization technologies such as AWS ECS, Kubernetes, Docker
Detailed knowledge of agile development methodologies
Foundational background of writing code with the ability to read code in a variety of languages, ideally Python, Go, JavaScript
Fundamental understanding of data modeling and impact on database designs, clustering and replication
Foundational background working and building in an API driven architecture, creating scalability for interconnected systems organization wide
Demonstrated experience engaging with all levels of management including senior level executives and proven ability to manage relationships both horizontally and vertically
Knowledge of software development lifecycles and Kanban/Agile methodologies
University bachelor’s degree in computer science or related experience

Competitive Total Rewards Package, including exclusive travel perks!
Additional days off, including on your birthday!

Enhanced Parental Leave
Meaningful Employee Recognition Program
Learning and Growth Opportunities
Employee Resource Groups

jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Role

At Rose BioSolutions, our capabilities span foundational research with human immune cells and stem cells to the complete advanced therapy manufacturing continuum. We are an established operation with a world-class team of experts, and we apply our R.O.S.E standard
to every program and relationship: Reliable, Outcome driven, Scalable, and Excellent!

This remote role can be based anywhere in the US
and
directly owns cybersecurity for the infrastructure organization, in addition to core infrastructure architecture and operations. As a newly independent company standing up its own IT function post carve-out, we do not yet have an MSP in place: this role will lead the evaluation, selection, and onboarding of our managed services partner(s), which may include a combined MSP/MSSP model or separate providers, then own ongoing SLA management and performance oversight.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will balance strategic architecture and security ownership with direct oversight of vendor selection, vendor delivery, incident response, and infrastructure roadmap execution in a fast-moving, newly standalone life sciences company. We are specifically looking for someone with prior carve-out or divestiture experience: someone who has designed and built a future-state IT infrastructure environment from a legacy or transitional foundation, not just operated within an already-established one. This person will also need to be comfortable leading a lean team while simultaneously running a major vendor selection process, and communicating infrastructure and security posture clearly to the CIO and executive leadership, including in a private equity-backed governance context.

Reports to:
CIO

Direct reports:
2–5, including on-site support resources across Rose Bio's four locations (Rockville, MD; Memphis, TN; Northridge, CA; Keele, UK)

Travel:
Regular travel expected across Rose Bio's four sites in the US and UK; frequency to be defined based on carve-out and MSP/MSSP transition milestones

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

MSP/MSSP Selection and Vendor Management

Lead the RFP, evaluation, and selection process for Rose Bio's first managed service provider(s), evaluating whether a combined MSP/MSSP model or separate specialized providers best fits the security and operational needs, defining scope, SLAs, and success metrics from the ground up
Own the MSP (and MSSP, if part of the same or a related contract) relationship end to end post-selection: onboarding, ticket escalations, quarterly business reviews, and ongoing contract and performance management against defined KPIs
Hold the MSP accountable for network, server, storage, help desk, and monitoring service delivery, and the MSSP (whether the same vendor or separate) accountable for security monitoring and response service levels
Clarify and manage the model for on-site support resources at each of the four locations, whether Rose Bio employees, MSP-provided resources, or a mix, as part of the vendor selection and org design process
Manage additional infrastructure vendors as needed

Cybersecurity

Own cybersecurity strategy, policy, standards, and risk posture for Rose Bio, whether execution is performed in-house or by an MSSP
Architect the security program and determine what is executed internally versus by an MSSP, similar to the MSP model: the Director owns the design and outcomes, the vendor executes against defined scope and SLAs
If an MSSP is engaged (standalone or combined with the MSP), own that relationship end to end: scope, SLAs, quarterly performance reviews, and accountability for security monitoring and response service levels
Own incident response decision-making and post-incident review, including working knowledge of SIEM tooling and alerting, even where an MSSP performs detection and triage
Own perimeter security posture, including firewall architecture and configuration, in coordination with the network team and any MSP/MSSP partner
Own identity and access governance, including provisioning, deprovisioning, periodic access reviews, and least-privilege standards
Own data privacy considerations across jurisdictions, including GDPR exposure at the Keele, UK site alongside applicable US requirements
Coordinate with OT security partners to ensure appropriate segmentation and monitoring of manufacturing-adjacent systems
Accountable to the CIO for the organization's overall security posture, regardless of which team or vendor performs day to day execution

Architecture

Own the overall infrastructure architecture strategy across network, server, storage, virtualization, and cloud, ensuring designs support scalability, security, and resilience
Set architectural standards and roadmap for a newly standalone company building its technology environment largely from scratch post carve-out
Make build vs. buy and on-prem vs. cloud architecture decisions in partnership with IT and business leadership
Ensure infrastructure design supports uptime, data integrity, and validation requirements typical of a GxP environment

Network, Servers, and Storage

Own lifecycle management for network infrastructure (LAN/WAN, firewalls, segmentation), server environments, and storage systems across all sites
Bring hands-on knowledge of firewall architecture, rule management, and perimeter design to guide both internal decisions and vendor oversight
Cloud and SaaS
Lead infrastructure strategy across Azure and/or AWS, including cost management, security posture, and architecture decisions
Oversee governance of the SaaS portfolio, including Office 365 and other business-critical SaaS platforms
Manage Active Directory (or Azure AD/Entra ID) and identity infrastructure

End User Computing and Help Desk

Ensure a reliable, well-supported end user computing environment across corporate and site locations
Oversee help desk performance delivered through the MSP, including SLA adherence and end user satisfaction
Virtualization and Data Center
Own virtualization strategy and platform management (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V)
Manage any remaining on prem data center footprint and its transition roadmap, where applicable

Monitoring, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

Ensure comprehensive monitoring coverage across infrastructure, with defined alerting and escalation paths
Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for infrastructure systems, including defined recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO), regular testing, and documentation
Own backup strategy and validation to ensure recoverability meets defined objectives
Maintain infrastructure documentation and runbooks to support audit readiness

IT Service Management

Own or oversee change management and ITSM processes, including ticketing, change control, and configuration management (CMDB), whether managed in-house or through the MSP

QUALIFICATIONS:

10+ years of progressive infrastructure leadership experience, including experience selecting and managing MSPs (not just inheriting an existing relationship)
Candidates must have direct or CDMO infrastructure experience.

Demonstrated expertise in infrastructure architecture across network, server, storage, virtualization, and cloud (Azure and/or AWS)
Strong working knowledge of Office 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, and enterprise SaaS management
Direct ownership experience of a cybersecurity program, including endpoint, identity, and vulnerability management, not just partnership with a separate security function
Hands on experience with incident management and SIEM tooling, and strong knowledge of perimeter security and firewall architecture
Experience with disaster recovery and backup planning, including defining and meeting RTO/RPO targets
Experience owning IT service management processes (change management, ticketing, CMDB)
Prior experience in a carve-out, divestiture, or newly independent company, with a track record of designing and building future-state infrastructure rather than only maintaining an existing environment
Experience managing budget for infrastructure and vendor spend
Comfort operating in a private equity-backed, board-visible environment, with strong written and verbal communication skills for CIO and executive-level reporting
Exposure to OT environments and IT/OT convergence in a manufacturing or lab setting a plus
Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation, or 21 CFR Part 11 a plus
Familiarity with SOC 2 or similar compliance frameworks a plus
Experience with multi-jurisdiction data privacy considerations (e.g., GDPR) a plus given the UK site
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience; relevant certifications (e.g., Azure/AWS, security) a plus

Why Join Us?

Impact:
Every process we design is a step toward a cure. You’ll be making a real impact on the health of people in your community and across the globe.
Expertise:
Work alongside a world-class team of scientists and operational leaders in a "no-ego" environment.
Stability & Growth:
We offer the security of an established operation with the career growth opportunities of a rapidly expanding organization.

Perks & Benefits

Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus opportunities.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) with company contribution.
Generous PTO and professional development support.

Rose BioSolutions is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Regression testing
Performance testing
Security testing
Release quality controls

Establish engineering quality metrics, standards, and governance processes.
Improve production quality, deployment confidence, and customer experience.
