Establish standards for:
Monitoring
Observability
Incident management
Root cause analysis
Problem management
Platform resiliency
Operational readiness

Build a highly effective support organization capable of supporting mission-critical business applications.
Drive improvements in uptime, service quality, support efficiency, and production stability.

Establish specialized engineering teams that can rapidly engage across strategic initiatives and critical technical challenges.
Build expert capabilities supporting:
Custom application development
AI implementation
Data engineering
Cloud engineering
Platform modernization
Performance optimization
Technical debt reduction
Production issue resolution

Provide expert technical resources that can accelerate delivery and solve the organization's most complex problems.
Act as the escalation point for significant technology and engineering challenges.
Talent Development & Organizational Leadership
Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent across multiple technical disciplines.
Build strong career paths across Engineering, AI, Data, Quality Engineering, and Production Support functions.
Develop future engineering leaders and technical experts.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
Establish technical communities of practice and skills development programs.

Must-Have Qualifications

15+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, technology delivery, or platform engineering.
8+ years of leadership experience managing large technical teams and complex engineering organizations.
Hands-on experience building and delivering enterprise-scale applications and technology platforms.
Proven experience leading organizations responsible for development, engineering enablement, testing, and production support.

AI and automation technologies
Data engineering
Platform engineering
DevOps and CI/CD
Quality engineering
Production operations

Experience building AI engineering and intelligent automation capabilities.

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner to lead the investments AI workstream and its product roadmap. This position is based in Boston, MA and offers the opportunity to partner closely with investment professionals, business leaders, architects, and engineers to define product roadmaps, prioritize investments, and deliver scalable solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong product management, investment domain expertise, and technology leadership to drive innovation, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across research, portfolio management, trading, risk, and investment operations.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Product Owner – Investments Technology, VP
you will:

Deliver measurable investment outcomes by executing the Agentic AI product roadmap and scaling reusable capabilities across research, portfolio management, trading, investment oversight, and investment risk.
Maximize return on AI investment by partnering with investment teams, AI Champions, and business leaders to prioritize opportunities with the greatest strategic value, feasibility, reuse potential, and risk-adjusted impact.
Accelerate value realization by converting priorities into clear product requirements, release decisions, evaluation criteria, and success measures, and leading cross-functional delivery from discovery through launch and optimization.
Achieve sustainable adoption and operational readiness by managing scope, risks, dependencies, stakeholder alignment, and roadmap performance through the investments AI Workstream.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Strong product management, strategic thinking, and business transformation capabilities.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change.
Demonstrated AI product leadership, with the ability to mobilize cross-functional teams, champion responsible AI, and drive adoption and measurable business value.
Experience leading complex cross-functional programs across business and technology teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
Ability to balance innovation, delivery execution, governance, and business outcomes.

Education And Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or related discipline.
5+ years of experience in Product Management, Technology Strategy, Digital Transformation, or related leadership roles within asset or investment management.
1+ year of experience driving AI, GenAI, or automation initiatives within asset management firms.
Knowledge of Data, Analytics, GenAI, Agentic AI, automation, and modern cloud-based technology ecosystems.
Experience working with Agile delivery models and cross-functional technology organizations.
Advanced degree in Business, Finance, Technology, Data Science, or related field preferred.
Product Management, Agile, Cloud, AI, or related industry certifications are a plus.

Additional Requirements

Ability to build effective partnerships across business, technology, architecture, risk, and compliance organizations.
Experience presenting strategies, roadmaps, and business cases to senior leadership.

$110,000 - $188,750 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.

What you’ll do

Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.

What you’ll bring

Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.

About The Team

The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$203,200—$345,600 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave

new_jobs.title: Director, Product Software Engineering | Platform Engineering and Architecture
new_jobs.description:
About the Role:

As a Director in Software Engineering, you will provide comprehensive leadership to senior managers and high-level professionals. You will have primary responsibility for the performance and results within your area, ensuring that all software engineering activities align with business strategies. Your role is crucial for steering the direction of major projects and technological advancements that will drive the company forward.

Job Description:

We are seeking a “full-stack” engineering Director to hire and lead a team that will be responsible for selection provides leadership to > 600 engineers on the use, adoption and automation around infrastructure as code, the operational management of container deployment platforms and the CI/CD and applications required. Additionally, they will be engaged on incidents for triage and resolution along with driving teams to implement automation to address., implement, and continuously improve the developer enablement and infrastructure platform, accelerating product delivery and operational excellence across Kubernetes-based environments. The ideal candidate will understand how to guide the definition, execution, and governance of release processes and platform capabilities; operates with broad latitude and accountability for outcomes aligned to divisional strategy. Work is performed without appreciable direction and is evaluated on execution against defined plans and strategy, with measurable impact on divisional results.

SUPERVISORY RELATIONSHIPS

Reports To: VP of Platform Engineering & Architecture
Supervises: Senior managers, managers, and high-level professionals across developer enablement, platform engineering, and SRE functions.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

Provide strategic leadership, vision, and roadmaps for developer enablement and infrastructure engineering in a highly matrixed organization; ensure alignment with business objectives and partner teams.
Establish clear objectives, success measures, and investment priorities for the platform, balancing reliability, velocity, cost, and risk.
Model inclusive collaboration and effective communication with senior management, peers, and subordinates to drive alignment and execution.
Drive adoption of AI Developer Tools to drive speed to market and reduce developer friction.

Developer Enablement Platform Ownership

Lead the Developer Enablement team that owns the platform for releasing container-based software to Kubernetes (K8s); define platform SLAs/SLOs, roadmaps, and service catalog.
Own Akuity/Argo CD (GitOps) administration and lifecycle; define guardrails, RBAC, multi-cluster promotion strategies, and drift detection/rollback practices.
Maintain and evolve Open Application Model (OAM) templates, golden paths, and paved-road workflows to standardize microservice onboarding and runtime config.
Govern end-to-end container release processes (policy, controls, approvals, and tooling), including promotion workflows, artifact provenance (SBOM/SLSA), and progressive delivery (blue/green, canary).
Integrate and Maintain Developer Enablement metrics reporting into central data lake environments.
Infrastructure Development & SRE Team Buildout
Staff, train, and mature a new team that becomes the core of infrastructure development and SRE; define role architecture, hiring profiles, onboarding plans, and growth paths.
Deliver platform capabilities as products (self-service, APIs, documentation, runbooks), enabling product teams to design, provision, and operate infrastructure consistently.
Train and assist engineering teams with infrastructure design and deployment (networking, storage, data, security, observability), while performing hands-on engineering to ensure deployments and operations are fully automated (IaC, GitOps, policy-as-code, CI/CD).
Establish site reliability practices—SLO/SLI, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, and capacity/performance engineering—aligned with product objectives.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

Define release governance and change management controls (e.g., segregation of duties, approval workflows, audit trails) integrated into platform tooling, partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance for continuous assurance.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and secure-by-design practices across the software supply chain.

Job Qualifications

Education
(Required):

Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and relevant experience in product software engineering.

Work Experience (Required):

Minimum 9+ years of relevant experience in product software engineering or platform/SRE leadership roles.
People management experience
Experience in Matrixed environments.
Knowledge and interest in AI
Technical competence in platform engineering and architecture

Preferred Experience & Knowledge (Role-Specific):

Platform engineering for Kubernetes at scale (multi-cluster/multi-region), GitOps (Argo CD/Akuity), service meshes, secrets management.
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi), policy-as-code (OPA/Gatekeeper), progressive delivery (Argo Rollouts/Flagger).
CI/CD at enterprise scale (artifact provenance, SBOM/SLSA), container security, and supply chain controls.
Observability platforms (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerts) and incident management practices.
Coaching product teams; operating in a matrixed enterprise with strong stakeholder management.

Skills / Competencies

Technical/Operational Skills

DevOps & Agile delivery; automation and continuous delivery at scale.
Cloud computing (Azure/AWS/GCP) and modern application architectures; API-first enablement.
Automation & Frameworks for standardized delivery and code manageability across teams.
Application Security and secure SDLC; Architectural Patterns for scalable, resilient systems.
Financial/Budget Management for platform services and shared-service cost models that includes understanding of how to use technology to drive cost reductions while increasing value delivery. This requires budget, technical and operational competencies.
Experience in both use of AI Coding tools personally and in driving adoption of those in developer teams.

Leadership Competencies

Accountability; Judgement & Decision-Making; Business Acumen to drive measurable outcomes.
Inclusive Collaboration; Inspiration & Alignment; Courage to take smart risks that enable innovation.
People Management: delegation, coaching, performance management, and talent development.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Velocity & Flow: Lead time for change; deployment frequency; PR cycle time (open-to-merge).
Reliability: Service SLO attainment; MTTI/MTTR; change failure rate.
Adoption & Self-Service: of services on Gantry; % workloads on paved paths/OAM templates; % infra as code.
Quality & Security: Policy compliance rate; supply-chain attestations; pipeline pass rate; vulnerability MTTR.
Experience & Enablement: Developer NPS; onboarding time to first deploy; “friction index” trend.
Overall infrastructure cost reduction while increasing all of the above.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Travel: 20%
Work Arrangement: Hybrid onsite in the WK posted locations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$179,200.00 - $320,200.00 USD

This role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information
:

Design and implement solutions EAD the execution of the AI strategy for Corporate Finance, , ensuring alignment with Nasdaq's global objectives and delivering significant business value.

new_jobs.description:
The Director, AI Platform Engineering & DevOp
s will be responsible for leading the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operational enablement of enterprise AI, Kubernetes, GPU, and DevOps platforms. This role partners with infrastructure engineering, application development, data science teams, and business stakeholders to design scalable, secure, cost-effective, and operationally sustainable AI and cloud-native platforms.

The role supports enterprise adoption of Private AI, Generative AI, GPU-based computing, Kubernetes-based platform services, RunAI capabilities, automation, and DevOps practices. The position is accountable for helping business and technical teams evaluate AI use cases, onboard workloads, optimize infrastructure investments, and accelerate developer and data science productivity.

Essential Functions

Define and drive architecture strategy for enterprise AI, Private AI, Generative AI, GPU, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platform services.
Lead design and evolution of scalable GPU infrastructure to support AI, machine learning, LLM, data science, and high-performance compute workloads.
Provide Kubernetes platform leadership, including workload orchestration, containerized platform design, resource management, scalability, reliability, and operational governance.
Advance DevOps practices across platform services, including CI/CD enablement, automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, deployment repeatability, and operational efficiency.
Partner with developers, data scientists, application architects, business architects, enterprise architecture, and business leaders to assess AI use cases and determine appropriate platform solutions.
Evaluate technology options, vendor capabilities, infrastructure designs, GPU configurations, networking, storage, and platform tooling to support enterprise AI objectives.
Drive adoption of AI platform services by conducting workshops, technical discovery sessions, onboarding activities, demos, and enablement sessions for development and data science teams.
Support platform users through onboarding, troubleshooting, technical guidance, requirements analysis, and operational support
Work with business and technical teams to ensure AI infrastructure solutions are not treated as simple checklist items, but are designed correctly for application, availability, migration, and business requirements.
Develop technical proposals, business cases, architecture recommendations, and cost optimization plans for AI and GPU platform investments.
Lead capacity planning and future-state roadmap development for AI platform growth, GPU expansion, workload onboarding, and Private AI adoption.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture teams to align AI and platform engineering capabilities with broader enterprise technology direction.
Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, enable on-prem AI alternatives, reduce public cloud AI service costs, and support business-driven AI initiatives.
Mentor and guide junior or supporting resources to scale platform support, improve knowledge transfer, and reduce dependency on senior architecture resources.
Ensure platform solutions are implemented in alignment with Enterprise Standards, InfoSec expectations, operational processes, and infrastructure best practices.

Experience Required

Requires extensive experience in enterprise infrastructure architecture, platform engineering, Kubernetes, DevOps, cloud-native technologies, AI/ML infrastructure, or high-performance computing environments.

Experience Should Include Several Of The Following

Designing and supporting enterprise Kubernetes or container platforms.
Supporting DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and infrastructure as code practices.
Architecting GPU-based infrastructure for AI, machine learning, or high-performance compute workloads.
Working with AI/ML platforms, Generative AI, LLM hosting approaches, or Private AI solutions.
Partnering with developers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Performing vendor evaluations, technical comparisons, platform recommendations, and cost-benefit analysis.
Leading complex cross-functional technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operational support.

Education Required

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
Equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant enterprise technology experience may be considered.

Additional Experience

Experience with RunAI or similar AI/GPU orchestration platforms preferred.
Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms and AI infrastructure ecosystems preferred.
Experience with hybrid cloud, private cloud, virtualization, networking, storage, and enterprise compute platforms preferred.
Experience supporting AI adoption, developer enablement, workshops, platform onboarding, or technical evangelization preferred.
Experience preparing executive-level architecture recommendations, investment proposals, and technical roadmaps preferred.

Key Skills And Abilities

Very strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare proposals, summaries, roadmaps, and executive-ready recommendations.
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, platform engineering, and cloud-native architecture.
Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, infrastructure as code, automation, and operational process improvement.
Strong understanding of GPU infrastructure, AI/ML workloads, LLM infrastructure requirements, and high-performance compute design.
Ability to evaluate complex technical options and recommend scalable, cost-effective, enterprise-ready solutions.
Ability to translate complex AI, infrastructure, and platform concepts into clear business and leadership recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across infrastructure, architecture, development, data science, and business teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on performance, scalability, resiliency, cost optimization, and operational readiness.
Ability to lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, demos, onboarding sessions, and enablement activities.
Ability to mentor technical resources and support knowledge transfer across teams.
Ability to work under limited direction and lead complex initiatives across multiple teams and priorities.

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane
, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane
—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable
.

Our mission
is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents
. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies
and platform engineers across 100+ countries
. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads
and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide
. We’re a Series B
company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital

to date. Learn more at upbound.io
.

Upbound is building the control plane for the modern enterprise. As the company behind Crossplane, the open-source CNCF project that extends Kubernetes into an AI-native cloud control plane, Upbound enables organizations to compose, manage, and operate infrastructure and services through declarative, programmable control planes. Upbound Cloud delivers hosted, multi-tenant control planes that power platform engineering teams at scale.

The Management Plane is how customers experience all of it. It is the unified API surface, the interface they work in, the catalog they discover content through, and the systems that connect, license, and bill everything they run. As we scale into the next phase of growth, we are hiring a Senior Manager to lead this group.

Areas of Ownership

Hub — The Upbound Hub API, which indexes and aggregates control planes across an organization and provides unified API access, multi-tenancy, and organization context regardless of where those control planes run.
Console — The primary frontend client and user experience for the entire Upbound platform, spanning single control plane views, multi-control-plane management, and organization-level operations.
Marketplace — The distribution and discovery layer where users and customers find providers, functions, configurations, and extensions.
Middleware — The platform services the business depends on: billing and metering, licensing and entitlements, Connect, and the identity and access plumbing that ties them together.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for growing a team, defining the architecture of the Management Plane, and ensuring these four surfaces operate as one coherent product rather than four adjacent ones.

In this role, you will …

Management Plane Strategy

Own the long-term technical direction for Hub, Console, Marketplace, and middleware. Ensure they present a single coherent experience to customers whether their control planes run in Upbound Cloud or in their own environment. Define the architectural direction for the Hub API, multi-tenancy, and organization-level identity and access management. Drive the reliability and performance standards these surfaces are held to.

Middleware and Commerce

Own the systems that turn product usage into revenue: metering, usage aggregation, billing, licensing, and entitlement enforcement. Ensure these systems are accurate, auditable, and resilient, and that they can support new packaging and pricing without a rewrite each time. Partner with Finance and Revenue on the operational side of billing correctness.

AI-Native Access

Ensure the Hub API is a first-class interface for autonomous agents as well as human operators, with the declarative, programmatic access agentic workflows require. Evolve the Console toward a multi-modal experience that works alongside those workflows rather than around them.

Team Leadership

Lead senior ICs and tech leads directly. Grow the team deliberately against the roadmap, raise the hiring bar, and develop engineers into senior and lead roles. Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, on-call ownership, and production excellence across the Management Plane surfaces.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product, Design, GTM, Finance, and Customer Success. Translate enterprise requirements around security, multi-tenancy, packaging, and entitlements into platform capabilities. Represent the Management Plane in conversations about pricing changes, packaging, and customer-facing reliability.

You are a good fit if you have…

7+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers directly
Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS products at scale
Strong API design fundamentals, including versioning, backward compatibility, and designing for third-party consumers
Hands-on experience with at least one commerce or platform middleware domain: billing, metering, licensing, entitlements, or identity and access management
Track record of owning production reliability for customer-facing services, including incident response and on-call culture
Has built or intentionally restructured a team, not only inherited one
Technically credible with senior and principal engineers while operating at the roadmap level

Skills / Traits

Leadership: Sets direction and quality standards for a group of senior engineers who need clarity more than supervision. Earns followership through judgment and technical credibility rather than title.
People Management: Develops engineers deliberately toward their next level, runs consistent 1:1s and feedback loops, and addresses underperformance directly instead of waiting for a review cycle.
Decision-Making: Makes calls with incomplete information on a surface where reversals are expensive. A published API, a data model, or a billing schema is hard to walk back, so the bar for thinking a decision through is higher here than in most teams.
Communication: Translates fluently between engineering, Product, Design, Finance, and GTM. Writes clearly enough that a pricing change or an API deprecation can be understood by everyone it affects without a meeting.
Problem-Solving: Drives to root cause on correctness problems rather than stopping at a mitigation. Comfortable reasoning about a discrepancy that only shows up in one tenant's invoice.
Prioritization: Balances roadmap commitments against revenue-blocking middleware work, reliability debt, and customer escalations, and can explain the tradeoff to the people who lost the argument.
Project Management: Delivers predictably across four tightly coupled surfaces where a Hub API change can block Console and Marketplace at the same time. Manages dependencies and sequencing without adding process for its own sake.
Adaptability: Absorbs shifts in packaging, pricing, and agentic access requirements without rearchitecting each time. Adjusts approach when a framework or plan stops serving the team.
Risk Management: Treats billing accuracy, entitlement enforcement, and API compatibility as areas where mistakes cost real money and customer trust. Builds the guardrails, auditability, and testing to catch problems before customers do.
Technical Proficiency: Credible in API design, multi-tenant data modeling, and identity and access patterns, with enough frontend depth to lead Console work substantively rather than defer on it.

It is a plus if you have…

Familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem
Frontend or full-stack depth, enough to lead Console work substantively
Experience with marketplaces, developer catalogs, or package distribution systems
Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the systems behind them
Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure or developer-tools companies
Familiarity with how AI agents consume infrastructure APIs

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

new_jobs.description:
Director of Manufacturing Engineering

Company Details:

Our company is a leader in the architectural metal products market with six operating locations in the USA. Family-owned and managed company 75 years strong. We distribute, fabricate, and finish (anodize and paint) aluminum and other products primarily for the commercial construction market.

This position will be responsible for 3 key areas:

Application Engineering and increasing revenue
Product Manager of ERP system
Engineering and Technical experience specifically with metal forming/fabrication and welding with Engineering CAD understanding.

The owners have been handling these job duties, but 1 of them is retiring in February, 2027 and would like a person to take over. Looking for experience in the metals industry and experienced with High Mix/Low Volume manufacturing environments. Essentially, possesses the final technical authority on manufacturability.

Mission

The Director of Manufacturing Engineering exists to turn technical uncertainty into revenue. When Sales brings a hard inquiry, this role's job is to know our true capability better than anyone on the floor, actively find the honest, buildable path to yes rather than defaulting to a cautious no, and build the investment case when winning the work requires new tooling. And when the honest answer really is no, this role says so — the goal is more revenue we can deliver on.

The Director of Manufacturing Engineering
is responsible for being the technical authority for how, where, and when shop orders are manufactured. This role owns enterprise-wide equipment and process capability knowledge, applying sound engineering judgment grounded in OEM specifications and hands-on manufacturing expertise to replace operator assumption and overly cautious decision-making.

Required:

Bachelor's degree in engineering (B.S.) from a four-year college or university; or ten years of related metal fabricating experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with ERP or production-scheduling systems is required.
Experienced with Lean Manufacturing philosophy and have experience with Lean tools such as visual manufacturing controls, 5S, waste reduction, and root cause analysis.
Prior application engineering or customer-facing technical solutioning experience is highly preferred.
Project management experience leading equipment installations, software deployments, or similar capital or process initiatives from planning through completion is required.
Familiarity with CAD is a plus.
Experience in a metal forming and welding environment is essential
Experience in Commercial Construction Building Products, especially aluminum window, door, skylight, curtain wall, and storefront would be a big plus.
Must have excellent communications skills

Job Responsibilities:

Serve as final technical authority on manufacturability: determine whether and how Company can fabricate and finish a given job in-house before sales quotes or declines work.
Serve as the application engineering escalation point: when Sales or a Project Manager brings a ‘can we make this?’ inquiry, actively work the problem — with Production personnel and customers as needed — to find an honest, buildable path to yes rather than defaulting to a cautious no, and equip Sales with what they need to convert a viable inquiry into a sale.
Train and equip Project Managers across all locations to make first-line manufacturability and solution decisions independently for standard requests, reserving engineering escalation for non-standard or complex jobs.
Assist with scheduling as needed: understand how Company Enterprise generates production schedules from quoted operations and standard time data, and guide General Managers, Project Managers, and administrative staff across all six branches on how to use and maintain accurate schedules.
Identify and recommend tooling and capital equipment investments that expand in-house capability, including cost and payback justification.
When Company is close to winning a job but cannot yet fulfill it without additional tooling or equipment, build a business plan for the CEO specific to that opportunity — investment required, cost, and payback — so capital decisions are made against real, near-term revenue rather than speculative capability building.
Serve as engineer-project manager for significant, approved engineering projects as needed — including new machine installations, software deployments, and other major process enhancements — owning scope, timeline, and budget from planning through completion.
Execute, configure, and maintain Company Enterprise's manufacturing ERP functionality under the CEO's product direction, including multi-branch job routing; document system logic and configuration so scheduling and routing knowledge does not depend on any single individual.
Directly manage the Compliance Management, CAD Services, and Quality Assurance functions.
Own the engineering aspects of regulatory compliance management.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance using Lean tools — visual manufacturing controls, 5S, waste reduction, and root cause analysis.
Monitor product consistency, customer complaints, safety hazards, and remakes across locations to identify systemic technical issues and drive corrective action.
Ensure staff receive timely, appropriate technical training and development. Mentor and develop staff through a supportive, collaborative approach.
Escalate unresolved disagreements with the VP of Manufacturing to the CEO for final decision.

new_jobs.description:
About Nira Energy

Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change
The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner
We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country
We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets
We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company
This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market

About The Role

This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.

The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.

The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.

Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.

The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e. <50 people and $10M in revenue, and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led in that capacity. You’ve also ideally held a prominent role at at a company that has scaled, i.e. 50-250 people and >$50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.

What you'll own

Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals
Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention
People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.
Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale

What we're looking for

A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat
A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value and can speak competently to results; i.e. Built a product from $0 to >$10M in revenue, Improve retention of a product by 30%, scaled a product from $10M to $50M etc
You are willing to be hands on and get in the weeds. This is a ~17 person org and a 30 person company. While you are ultimately in charge of managing the team we expect you to be a hands on operator and willing to roll your sleeves up
Ability and interest in learning a highly niche, complex domain fast. Transmisison planning is incredibly intricate and becoming fluent in the language of “transmission” is critical to success in the role
Low ego and mission driven. Your energized by the mission of the company and by building a team, motivating them, and partnering with world class founders
Excellent communication and people leadership skills

Ideal backgrounds

VP Product / CPO at a technical B2B SaaS company.
GM of a complex technical product line.
A product leader who has run a team or product function end to end.
A former technical or product founder who scaled into executive leadership.
Bonus points for experience in energy, grid infrastructure, climate, utilities, transmission, interconnection, or power markets, but not required

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About The Role

Forward Deployed Engineering is where Chalk meets its customers. Our FDEs are exceptional software engineers who integrate Chalk’s platform with the best ML and engineering teams in healthcare, finance, and consumer technology — running technical pilots that win deals, onboarding new customers, and engineering feature pipelines that power use cases like fraud prevention, cancer detection, and product recommendation.

Working directly with our founders, you'll lead this team and define its future. You'll own the strategy for how Chalk engages customers technically — from pre-sales pilots through onboarding, support, and expansion — and build the organization, processes, and playbooks that let the function scale with our growth. FDE is one of the most strategically important and fastest-growing functions at Chalk, and this role will shape what it becomes.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What You Will Do

Lead, develop, and retain Chalk's team of Forward Deployed Engineers across New York and San Francisco, and own an aggressive hiring plan as the team scales
Define the strategy and operating model for the FDE function: engagement models, account coverage, the pre-sales/post-sales balance, and how FDEs drive expansion within accounts

Lead and execute the company’s technology roadmap, ensuring day-to-day operations align with business strategy and brand objectives.

Upbound is building the control plane for the modern enterprise. As the company behind Crossplane, the open-source CNCF project that extends Kubernetes into an AI-native cloud control plane. Upbound enables organizations to compose, manage, and operate infrastructure and services through declarative, programmable control planes. Upbound Cloud delivers hosted, multi-tenant control planes that power platform engineering teams at scale. Our vision extends beyond infrastructure management into an AI-native Control Fabric — where control planes become programmable, extensible, and ecosystem-driven. As we scale into the next phase of growth, we are hiring a Director to lead our Control Planes & Ecosystem Group.

Crossplane: Upstream work and contributions for the open source Crossplane Project
Upbound Crossplane: Upbound’s Enterprise Distribution of Crossplane

Control Plane & Enterprise Strategy

Shape how platform engineering teams compose infrastructure through Crossplane-powered abstractions.

Enable extension frameworks that allow customers and partners to build on top of Upbound control planes.
Ensure ecosystem experiences are intuitive, secure, and enterprise-ready.

Organizational Leadership

Lead managers and managers-of-managers across multiple teams.
Scale engineering org structure to support product velocity and ecosystem expansion.
Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, uptime SLAs, and production excellence.

Cross-Functional Influence

Translate enterprise customer needs into scalable control plane capabilities.
Represent engineering in executive-level conversations around ecosystem expansion and AI-native infrastructure.

Deep familiarity with Kubernetes and the Cloud Native ecosystem.
Experience building SaaS control planes or distributed systems at scale.
Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, declarative systems, and extensibility frameworks.
Proven experience growing ecosystem-driven products (marketplaces, providers, plugins, or integrations).
Track record of delivering reliable production services with strong uptime and performance standards.

Experience with Crossplane and/or Kubernetes.
Background in platform engineering or internal developer platforms.
Experience building multi-tenant control plane architectures.
Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure companies.
Passion for programmable infrastructure and AI-native systems.

If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

What We’re Looking For:
Iridium is seeking a Director, Software Engineering Ground Systems Development reporting to the VP, Engineering who will be a key member of a leadership team developing Department of Defense (DoD) / Intelligence Community government space programs. You will lead and oversee all design, implementation, integration, and transition to operations for these ground systems. Manage the staffing and solution strategy of the Ground Software Development team, including identifying skills and experience needed for new hires, developing existing team skillsets, and supporting existing and evolving team tasks including new government projects

15+ years of relevant experience in the satellite ground development industry, including experience with USG satellite development programs

Software development expertise including agile development process and demonstrated success with large scale software development projects
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present information, drive discussion, and respond to difficult scenarios with limited preparation across all employee groups

We believe in-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. and

Reports to:
CIO

Direct reports:
2–5, including on-site support resources across Rose Bio's four locations (Rockville, MD; Memphis, TN; Northridge, CA; Keele, UK)

Travel:
Regular travel expected across Rose Bio's four sites in the US and UK; frequency to be defined based on carve-out and MSP/MSSP transition milestones

MSP/MSSP Selection and Vendor Management

Maintain infrastructure documentation and runbooks to support audit readiness

Candidates must have direct or CDMO infrastructure experience.

Demonstrated expertise in infrastructure architecture across network, server, storage, virtualization, and cloud (Azure and/or AWS)
Strong working knowledge of Office 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, and enterprise SaaS management
Direct ownership experience of a cybersecurity program, including endpoint, identity, and vulnerability management, not just partnership with a separate security function
Hands on experience with incident management and SIEM tooling, and strong knowledge of perimeter security and firewall architecture
Experience with disaster recovery and backup planning, including defining and meeting RTO/RPO targets
Experience owning IT service management processes (change management, ticketing, CMDB)
Prior experience in a carve-out, divestiture, or newly independent company, with a track record of designing and building future-state infrastructure rather than only maintaining an existing environment
Experience managing budget for infrastructure and vendor spend

Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation, or 21 CFR Part 11 a plus

new_jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
new_jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.

What you’ll do

Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.

What you’ll bring

Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.

About The Team

The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity.
